items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: The lady that raised me, their names were Wodard, W-o-d-a-r-d.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. My mother's -- I have pictures of her. She looks just like an Indian, you know. The lady that raised me, their names were Wodard, W-o-d-a-r-d. And they were very religious. I spent all my life in church. I never missed a Sunday in church unless I was sick. I taught Sunday school. My mother --
